about_the_game:
Avatars is an AI-powered creative sandbox and social role-play experience where you design unique characters and bring them to life. Choose a name, photo, backstory, and personality tone to shape your creation, then release it into the community for others to discover and interact with.


Each avatar uses artificial intelligence to generate dynamic conversations and unique behaviors based on the traits you define, making every interaction feel personal and alive.


The game offers a wide set of features:


  • AI-Driven Personalities: Every avatar has its own conversational style and logic powered by artificial intelligence, adapting to its mood, tone, and story.
  • Avatar Creation: Build characters in minutes by combining names, images, biographies, and personality traits.
  • Role-Play & Interaction: Talk naturally with your avatars or those created by other players—each responds in real time according to its defined personality.
  • Community Sharing: Publish your creations and explore a growing library of AI-generated characters made by others.
  • Voting & Discovery: Rate community avatars, climb the charts, and find unique personalities shared by fellow players.
  • Endless Variety: Create celebrities, historical figures, fictional heroes, or completely original personas—your imagination sets the limit.
  • Quick Sessions or Long Play: Jump in for a short AI chat or spend hours expanding your collection and developing complex personalities.

Avatars is not about winning or losing, but about creativity, imagination, and AI-powered social play. Build your personal collection, interact with living characters, and share the avatars that only you could imagine.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64 Bits)
  • Processor: AMD FX-8320
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1660
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Highly recommended: CUDA Toolkit (Increase the Ai response time), Internet required to download the ai model (First time)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64 Bits)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 or upper
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Highly recommended: CUDA Toolkit (Increase the Ai response time), Internet required to download the ai model (First time)
